name: Clockwork Sentinel, Supercharged
body:
SUPERCHARGED CLOCKWORK SENTINEL
CR 5

This man-sized figure formed from metal is twitching slightly as arcane clockwork mechanisms spin within its body.

XP 1,600
N Medium construct
Init +8; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +5

DEFENSE

AC 19, touch 16, flat-footed 13 (+4 Dex, +3 natural, +2 dodge)
hp 53 (6d10+20)
Fort +5, Ref +11, Will +5
SR 15
Immune construct traits
Weaknesses vulnerable to electricity

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft.
Melee 2 slam +10 (1d10+4)

STATISTICS

Str 18, Dex 18, Con -, Int -, Wis 10, Cha 2
Base Atk +4; CMB +4, CMD 16
Feats Improved Initiative, Lightning Reflexes

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Clockwork Wind-up (Ex)

The Clockwork Sentinel is now able to attack with both arms without any wind-up time. It has two slam attacks as standard.
